publisher_name: Civilization (self-published by Richard Turley and Lucas Mascatello)
independence_evidence: A self-published New York newspaper made by its two founders since 2018; the publisher's site is a bare Cargo page listing stockists for Issue 7 and a Gmail contact, with no company or media-group behind it.
qualifies_reason: Independent self-published New York broadsheet whose seventh issue appeared in September 2025 and is stocked internationally.
what_it_is: Civilization is an occasional large-format newspaper about New York City, printed on heavy newsprint as a dense 16-page broadsheet of overheard conversations, lists, confessions, diary fragments and artist contributions set in tiny type under bold coverlines. It appears irregularly, roughly one issue every year or two since 2018, and is sold through art bookshops and magazine stores. It suits readers of art publishing and city writing who enjoy a disorderly, text-heavy object rather than a conventional magazine.
uncertainties: The publisher's site is script-rendered (Cargo) and shows only a contact page with a list of Issue 7 stockists; it has no shop, so no cover price could be recorded and no cover image was obtained (the magCulture Civilization 7 listing, formerly the best image source, now returns 404 and the Public Knowledge Books listing in the hint could not be found by search). The Issue 7 date (September 2025) comes from an Interview magazine piece dated 12 September 2025 marking the issue's release; the trim size and page count (420 x 580 mm, 16 pages) come from a stockist description found via search rather than the publisher. Frequency is irregular: issue 6 appeared in 2022 and issue 7 in 2025.
